title: Bringing Nunchaku 4-bit Diffusion Inference to Diffusers
author: Hugging Face Blog
summary: This post introduces the integration of Nunchaku's 4-bit diffusion inference into the Diffusers library, enabling faster and more memory-efficient image generation. It explains how quantizing model weights to 4-bit reduces resource usage while maintaining quality, and provides simple APIs for Hugging Face users to adopt.
